atoms.name: knob-rotary
atoms.description: Round rotary control with a value/glyph at center and a partial arc indicating value. The canonical 'angular' knob: butt-cap strokes, ivory default, brass for one lit signal max.
atoms.canonical_reason: Only file that documents all four knob 'roles' (range, boolean, options, button) on one card with explicit aesthetic rules in the caption.
variants_found: 96px SVG arc — components-knobs.html (canonical, butt caps, 8px stroke ivory, brass arc only on the one lit knob)
80px SVG arc with beat-pulse scale animation — mot-compositions-beat-room.html
~60px SVG arc, simpler — mot-compositions-state-cascade.html
ROLE: Range (partial arc + numeric)
ROLE: Boolean (full arc + center ball, brass glow)
ROLE: Options (full ring + two opposing tick segments rotated to position)
ROLE: Button (faint ring + spinning 25% segment for live/loading)
atoms.drift_notes: Only components-knobs.html follows the documented butt-cap angular spec. mot-compositions-beat-room and mot-compositions-state-cascade duplicate the SVG-arc treatment at different sizes (60/80) with no shared sizing scale documented.

atoms.name: knob-dial-faux
atoms.description: Purely visual/decorative 'knob' rendered as a small radial-gradient disc with a value label below. NOT the canonical SVG-arc knob — it has no arc, no tick, no real angle indicator. Used as a value-display pill that looks knob-like.
atoms.canonical_reason: Uses an actual conic-gradient ring (--p variable) so it at least implies an angle. composition-drawer.html drops the ring entirely and is just a circle with a number.
variants_found: 52px disc, radial gradient ink-4→ink-2, NO angle indicator, just value text — composition-drawer.html (key/mode/bpm/oct/rows row)
64px disc, conic-gradient ring with --p custom property, value text — composition-motion-overview.html
atoms.drift_notes: MAJOR DRIFT. These are not real knobs — they're decorative value chips dressed as knobs. composition-drawer.html ones have no angle indicator at all; composition-motion-overview.html uses conic-gradient which doesn't match the SVG-arc primitive from components-knobs.html. Three completely different rendering techniques (SVG arc / conic gradient / no indicator) all called 'knob'. Pick ONE knob primitive and refactor all three compositions.

atoms.name: tile-solfege
atoms.description: The colored keyboard cell carrying syllable + pitch + corner pos. The only place chromatic color wears a full fill. Square aspect, tiny ink stroke, paper-grain overlay, dark variant for cool side of wheel (Se/Le/Te).
atoms.canonical_reason: Single-purpose primitive card with full state matrix (rest, hover, active, played, disabled) and anatomy callouts. Spec is explicit: 130sq · r4 · 1px ink stroke, Jazz 38/pitch 18/pos JBM 9 cap.
variants_found: 130×130 fixed square, r4 — components-solfege-tile.html (canonical)
aspect-ratio: 1.05 / 1, syll 26px, pitch 14px — composition-drawer.html (smaller drawer tile)
aspect-ratio: 1.05 / 1, syll 36px, pitch 20px — composition-motion-overview.html
110×110 fixed — composition-motion-overview.html (flash-target demo)
aspect-ratio: 1.05 / 1, r4, syll 22px — mot-compositions-beat-room.html
STATES: rest, hover (brightness +12%), active (2px inset ivory), played (lift 3px + self-hue glow), disabled (desaturate + cross-slash)
ANIMATIONS: bob on &-of-beat (mot-primitives-tile-bob, mot-compositions-beat-room), played-flash (mot-primitives-played-flash, composition-motion-overview)
atoms.drift_notes: Syllable size varies wildly across compositions: 38/36/26/22px. Pitch size: 18/20/14/12px. No documented 'size scale' for tiles. composition-motion-overview.html and mot-compositions-beat-room.html both inline raw HSL values for tile background instead of using --note-do…--note-ti tokens (composition-drawer uses HSL too). The dark-tile color tokens for played/active in compositions are inlined inline-styles, not classes. Many compositions skip the paper-grain ::after overlay.

atoms.name: tile-swatch
atoms.description: Tiny color-swatch cell used in token/scale grids — NOT an input, but uses the .tile class name. Flagged for naming collision.
atoms.canonical_reason: Only file using this; could be renamed to .swatch to avoid collision with the solfège tile primitive.
variants_found: 12-column aspect-1 swatch grid with JBM 9px labels
atoms.drift_notes: Class name 'tile' collides with the solfège tile primitive. Rename to .swatch to avoid future drift confusion.

atoms.name: key-clip-paper
atoms.description: Piano/keypad style row: full-color colored key with clip-path cut-paper trapezoid, inset bottom shadow, white syllable + small pitch. A different visual family from tile-solfege (lighter chrome, more pill-like).
variants_found: 7 keys, 64px height, r14, clip-path trapezoid, white text on chromatic fill, syll in cap + small pitch
atoms.drift_notes: Tension with tile-solfege: both are 'the colored note thing'. tiles use ink (dark) text on fill; keys use white text. tiles use r4; keys use r14. Either consolidate to one primitive with text-color variants, or document explicitly when to use which (this card says 'main octave' but doesn't explain when to choose keys over tiles).

Refactor components-preset-card.html to match.

global_notes: Inputs are the worst drift area, as flagged. Key findings: (1) THREE different knob rendering techniques (SVG-arc, conic-gradient, no-indicator-just-a-circle) all called 'knob' across the codebase — pick one. (2) Tile syllable typography varies 22/26/36/38px with no documented size scale. (3) There is NO standalone primitive specimen for the paper/ivory pill button, the ghost text button, or the segmented tab row — all live only inside compositions and drift slightly each time. (4) Sliders/range inputs do NOT exist in the system. Drawer composition has 'Haptic feedback ON · MEDIUM' as text-only — there is no slider atom anywhere. The token sheet mentions 'radius-pill 999px · Toggles only' but no toggle primitive is implemented. (5) Class-name collisions: .seg is used for both segmented tabs (composition-drawer) and 7-segment numeric displays (components-chip); .tile is used for the solfège keyboard cell and for color-swatch grids. (6) Sharp-corner vs rounded-corner inconsistency: components-preset-card.html and components-buttons.html .ico use r6-r12, while composition-drawer/composition-pattern-reel icon-btns and preset-rows use r0 — the poster spec says r0 should win. (7) Multiple icon-btn sizes (26/28/32/40/48) need a documented 'micro' tier or consolidation.
